neighbours.label: Straight line pieces that make up a geometric figure: sides, edges and segments of polygons, and sticks or toothpicks used to build shapes; not 'sides' or 'sticks' outside geometry
fire: An octagon has eight sides and eight angles.
Arrange twelve matchsticks so that they form four small squares.
The two longer sides of the trapezoid are not parallel.
Using only six straws, the students had to build four triangles.
Draw a line segment from the top corner of the square to the midpoint of the base.
A rhombus is a quadrilateral whose four sides all have the same length.
Move three toothpicks to turn the triangle pattern upside down.
The perimeter is the sum of the lengths of all the sides of the polygon.
quiet: An octopus has eight arms and three hearts.
Keep the matchsticks in a dry tin so that they light on the first strike.
The two longer chapters of the novel are not connected.
Using only six eggs, the students had to bake four cakes.
Take a bus from the top of the hill to the middle of the town.
A quartet is a group whose four members all play string instruments.
Both sides in the dispute agreed to meet again in the spring.
The total is the sum of the prices of all the items in the basket.
